201:t_004:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll take back the peace you stole from everyone!」

201:t_004:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The $$翠の地球$$ and the $$蒼の地球$$ too...!」

201:t_004:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time for a solution through dialogue has already passed!」

201:t_004:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin your attack! First, break through the defensive line!」

201:t_004:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In this battle, we'll strike at the heart of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

201:t_004:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood, $n! We're coming back alive, no matter what!」

201:t_004:16.en:
$n
「But I'll give it everything I've got!」

201:t_005:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「We've broken through the defensive line!」

201:t_005:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Now we just have to charge into the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like the main event is here.」

201:t_007:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$...! And $$バルビエル$$ too!」

201:t_007:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So those two $$リアクター$$s were here after all!」

201:t_007:4.en:
$n
「No...! There aren't just two $$リアクター$$s!」

201:t_007:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That battleship at the very back...」

201:t_007:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Don't tell me that one's also...!」

201:t_007:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「A $$スフィア・リアクター$$!?」

201:t_007:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「He isn't very talkative. We'll introduce him.」

201:t_007:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If even you say that, $$ストラウス$$ is hopeless.」

201:t_007:14.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's the name $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ mentioned...」

201:t_007:15.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「He is Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$. As his title suggests, he commands all the $$新地球皇国$$'s armed forces.」

201:t_007:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「He is also the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$欲深な金牛$$'.」

201:t_007:18.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「He's the Taurus $$リアクター$$...!」

201:t_007:20.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Then his ship is the Empire's flagship.」

201:t_007:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「Fine by me! We'll just blow away everyone who comes at us!」

201:t_007:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll crush the Supreme Commander before the Emperor!」

201:t_007:25.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You've already fallen into $$ストラウス$$'s trap.」

201:t_007:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What will you do? Turn back?」

201:t_007:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But you can't, can you? You're carrying everyone's hopes.」

201:t_007:30.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Since you've barged into the capital, we'll exterminate you.」

201:t_007:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't talk about people like they're vermin!」

201:t_007:32.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「They are all living things. There is no difference.」

201:t_007:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「How the meaning of those words changes depending on who says them...」

201:t_007:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we came here with the resolve to face this too...!」

201:t_007:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin your attack! We can't reach the Imperial Palace without defeating the $$リアクター$$s!」

201:t_007:38.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You don't need to give me orders. I'll dispose of them here.」

201:t_007:41.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... Please get ready to eject.」

201:t_008:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This power... It's on a completely different level!」

201:t_008:1.en:
$n
「So this is what they're like when they're serious...!」

201:t_008:4.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A machine is approaching this area at high speed!」

201:t_009:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's... the one we sealed inside the 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》 on $$火星$$...」

201:t_009:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's been a while, $$セツコ$$. You too, $$ランド$$.」

201:t_009:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's a shame $$クロウ$$ isn't here, but I see there's a new $$リアクター$$.」
